about.p1: Passionate about authentic Asian cuisine, I had the chance to live in Guangzhou, China, where I immersed myself in the heart of traditional Chinese gastronomy.
about.p2: This unique experience allowed me to work alongside talented cooks from various Asian countries, enriching my mastery of culinary techniques and my understanding of authentic flavors.
about.p3: Today in Reunion Island, I share this culinary richness by offering gastronomic experiences that combine tradition and creativity, to make you discover the true essence of Asian cuisine.

gallery.p1: Discover a preview of my culinary creations. Photos are currently being professionally improved.
gallery.item4: Malaysian style breaded fish and Sichuan style soy sprout
gallery.item5: Chinese style pork with vegetables and eggplant
gallery.item9: Spicy and sweet chicken and green vegetables

testimonials.t1_text: An extraordinary experience! The chef prepared an authentic Chinese menu at our home. The flavors were incredible and the service impeccable.
testimonials.t2_text: The cooking classes allowed me to learn true Asian techniques. I highly recommend this unique experience!
testimonials.t3_text: Regular order of takeout dishes. Consistent quality and authentic flavors. A real culinary journey with every meal.
